# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.71

## Changed

- Multi-RX RX Profile Sync review hides already-matching historical rows by
  default. Enable **Show matching records too (history review)** to include
  disabled matching rows during historical review.

## Safety

- Scans remain read-only; only pending-difference rows can be selected for
  manual, audited synchronization. No migration or business-data change.
